Players frequently use it to increase their [[max melee hit|max hit]]. At level 50 [[Crafting]], players can craft a ruby amulet. With at least 49 [[Magic]], [[Lvl-3 Enchant]] can be cast on a ruby amulet to create an amulet of strength.
